facts.text: Reference-sheet layout: one large hero image across the top and two rows of smaller panels below, all separated by thin dark dividers on a near-black background.

The top hero panel depicts a large black dragon standing in a volcanic landscape, with jagged dark rock formations, glowing orange lava cracks, dark smoke, and a wet foreground surface reflecting the creature.
The dragon is covered in dark scales with subtle iridescent blue-teal highlights, has a long ridged neck, a row of sharp spikes running from head to tail, and a long spiked tail curving behind it.

The dragon's head bears several long, pale ivory-colored horns swept backward, a ridged brow, and a slightly open jaw; the head is lowered toward the ground with a quadrupedal, forward-leaning stance and clawed feet planted on the rock.
Large membranous wings with visible dark bone struts are raised and partly spread; in the hero panel one wing is extended high and to the right, partially cropped by the frame.

Middle row contains three full-body turnaround panels labeled "FRONT", "SIDE PROFILE", and "REAR", showing the same dragon in spread-wing frontal view, side view with wings folded back, and rear view respectively.

Bottom row contains four detail panels labeled "HEAD CLOSE", "WING MEMBRANE", "CLAW AND FOOT", and "SCALE DETAIL"; the head close-up shows a small amber-orange eye and pale horns, the wing membrane is dark and leathery with radial struts, the foot detail shows thick scaled toes with curved dark claws, and the scale detail shows overlapping ridged scales with blue-green sheen.
On-screen text is legible in white capital letters beneath the panels.

limitations: Only a single still frame is available, so no motion, behavior over time, audio, or dialogue can be observed.
Fine surface texture and exact color values in the detail panels are only partially resolvable at this resolution.

description.text: A dark character reference sheet fills the frame, laid out in clean panels on deep charcoal. Across the top, a wide hero panel shows a rain-soaked elevated walkway at night: metal railings on both sides, wet paving throwing back cool blue rain streaks and warm amber streetlight, blurred city lights and buildings beyond. At the center of that walkway a single figure stands in a black collared tactical jacket, dark shirt, black trousers and black boots, short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, head turned slightly aside. Below the hero panel, three full-body turnaround views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK present the same figure upright with arms relaxed at the sides against a plain studio gray. Along the bottom, four close-ups labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS detail a neutral direct gaze, black fabric with zipper and rectangular buckle strap, bare knuckled hands with dark smudges, and scuffed lace-up combat boots with thick soles. Every panel, divider, studio backdrop, figure position and existing label stays exactly where it is, uncropped and unredrawn; the sheet holds unbroken, and in the final moments a slow dissolve begins to creep across its surface.
The complete first reference sheet is held exactly as supplied, its hero panel, turnaround row, detail row and all existing labels intact.
A slow dissolve begins to overtake the intact sheet, softening the panel edges without displacing any element.
The camera holds a static shot.

The dissolve completes and the second sheet stands whole: a dark-fantasy creature reference sheet with the same paneled architecture and thin dark dividers on a near-black field. The wide top panel places a large black dragon on volcanic ground, heavy scales carrying blue-teal iridescence, several long pale ivory horns swept back over a ridged brow, a slightly open jaw lowered toward the rock, a row of sharp spikes running from neck to a long curved spiked tail, and large membranous wings with dark bone struts partly spread, one wing rising high and cropped by the frame edge. Jagged black rock, glowing orange lava cracks, drifting smoke and a wet reflective foreground surround the creature. The middle row holds three full-body turnarounds labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and REAR, and the bottom row holds four close-ups labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT and SCALE DETAIL, showing a small amber-orange eye, leathery membrane with radial struts, thick scaled toes with curved claws, and overlapping ridged scales with a blue-green sheen. All panels, dividers, backdrop and existing labels remain intact and uncropped as the sheet settles and is held to the end.
The slow dissolve continues across the paneled surface, drawing the creature sheet up out of the fading character sheet.
The dissolve finishes and the complete second reference sheet is held motionless, every panel and label visible.
The camera holds a static shot.
